description: Introducing the Security MCP, your go-to tool for open-source vulnerability lookups using OSV.dev. With a simple API call, developers can quickly identify security issues in their npm, PyPI, and Go packages without any authentication barriers. Ideal for software engineers, security teams, and DevOps professionals, this tool streamlines the process of securing code and maintaining integrity in software projects. Start improving your code security today with our easy-to-use interface!
